title: Vikram and Betal: The Broken Promise

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a man who breaks promises.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a man who did not keep promises.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.summary: The man fails to help his friend.
scenes.text: The man broke his promise and did not help his friend.
scenes.image_prompt: friend waiting while man does not come cartoon

scenes.text: The man asked his friend for help later.
scenes.image_prompt: man asking friend for help cartoon

scenes.text: The friend refused because the promise was broken.
The man learned to keep promises. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.

story: A man broke his promise and lost trust. Later, he learned the importance of keeping promises. Vikram said trust depends on promises.
